sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hol*? asks where someone or something is. The location phrase normally comes before van in a simple location sentence.

items.english: The bag is in the room.

sections.content: Notice where van lands: not next to Hol, but tucked at the very end of the answer, after the location phrase — A táska a szobában van, literally ‘the bag in-the-room is.’ Hungarian likes to save the verb for last in simple statements like this, so train your ear to expect van as the closer, not the opener.
